source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Stress all approved HDD/SSD/NVMe volumes with IOmeter at 16 outstanding I/Os for at least 48 hours to exercise PCIe/NVMe communication and stability.
procedure_facts: Bring all drives online, format each as its own volume, select all volumes and the `Default` access specification in GUI.
IOmeter may spend hours in Preparing Drives before the workload.
criteria_facts: No reported errors, system hangs or reboots.
missing_source_information: Exact target drive/volume map excluding boot/OS/protected data.
IOmeter version/config and meaning of Default access specification.
Whether 48 hours excludes preparation, per-volume capacity/test-file limits, health/thermal/endurance and recovery.

original_test_intent.statement: After approved destructive volume provisioning, run one frozen IOmeter workload concurrently across every designated storage volume with 16 outstanding I/Os for a full 48-hour measurement window, proving no I/O errors, hangs or reboots and preserving drive/bus health evidence.
must_preserve: All approved drives as separate volumes.
QD/outstanding I/O 16, approved access specification and minimum 48-hour active test.
must_not_infer: All physical drives includes OS/boot or protected media.
Preparing Drives time counts toward 48 active hours.
What `Default` workload means across IOmeter versions.
That GUI launch or a headless worker alone proves completion.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly treats this as destructive hybrid execution requiring licensed tool/config, explicit non-OS volumes, format/write approval, 48-hour evidence and recovery ownership.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not explicitly separate formatting, test-file preparation and the 48-hour active window, pin the `Default` access profile contents, or require per-volume worker/target coverage and before/after endurance/health.

related_records: fio or single-drive cases cannot define IOmeter GUI/config, all-volume concurrency or 48-hour completion.
applicable_history.precedence_application: Manual configuration plus automated worker/evidence is hybrid REQUIRES, not MANUAL ONLY or BLOCKED.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: The 48-hour workload can be automated after an operator provisions only signed sacrificial volumes and exports a validated IOmeter configuration; preparation never substitutes for the full active window.

conditions_present: All-volume intent, outstanding-I/O 16 and minimum 48 hours are explicit.
missing: Target/exclusion map, exact config/workload, provisioning/preparation/active timing, tool/worker versions, thresholds, endurance/thermal limits, monitoring and restore.
provider: Storage owner designates sacrificial drives/volumes and accepts format/data loss/endurance.
Test owner exports signed IOmeter config and timing semantics.
Lab/operator provisions volumes and approves long-run recovery.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory persistent drive/volume/controller/topology, boot/data/swap/RAID/LVM dependencies, IOmeter availability, health/endurance/temperature, free space and logs.
prohibited_until_resolved: Online/format/partition, test-file preparation, GUI/worker launch, writes, log clearing or PASS.
closure_evidence: Two-view target exclusion for every drive.

revision_candidate.test_name: Run a 48-Hour IOmeter Stress Test across All Approved Storage Volumes
revision_candidate.purpose: After approved provisioning, run the exact IOmeter access profile concurrently against every signed sacrificial HDD/SSD/NVMe volume for a full 48-hour active measurement, and verify no I/O error, hang, reboot or unacceptable device/bus health change. Preserve the source's Disk Targets setting of 16 outstanding I/Os, but do not execute until the owner documents whether IOmeter applies that setting per worker, selected target, disk or total in the approved configuration.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact Windows/IOmeter/Dynamo versions, drive/controller/PCIe topology, firmware/driver, volume/filesystem/cache/power policy and exported IOmeter configuration. HDD, SATA SSD and NVMe behavior and endurance are evaluated per device class.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every drive on the signed sacrificial list as its own volume, with persistent identity and explicit exclusion of OS/boot/recovery/pagefile/data/RAID/protected media. The source records the UI value 16 under Disk Targets; its effective per-worker/target/disk/total scope is a required owner decision and configuration proof, not a profile already fixed by this contract. Formatting and Preparing Drives are setup; the active workload must run at least 48 hours afterward.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Drive/volume identity and exclusion map; data-loss/format/endurance approval; IOmeter installer/hash/license and worker version; exported config with manager/worker-to-volume map, exact access specification, transfer/read-write/random mix, queue semantics, test-file size/range, ramp/update interval and 48-hour duration; cache/power state; per-class limits; telemetry/heartbeat/reboot detection; restore/reprovision.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Operator provisions only signed volumes and loads the validated config; Agent may launch/monitor a supported worker/config interface but not improvise GUI clicks. Record separate provisioning and preparation intervals, prove every worker/target is active, then start the 48-hour timer only when all volumes enter the workload. Capture continuous per-volume results, errors, health, PCIe/AER and host heartbeat/boot-ID evidence; stop and restore under the approved plan.
revision_candidate.preconditions: All targets sacrificial and excluded; config dry-reviewed; tool licensed/pinned; sufficient space/endurance/cooling/power; no production I/O; monitoring, maintenance window and recovery tested.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Persistent drive/volume/controller map and exclusion proof; format/provisioning approval/log; IOmeter/Dynamo/config hashes; manager/worker/target map; all profile settings including exact meaning of Default; preparation start/end; at least 48 active hours with timestamps/heartbeats; complete per-volume IOPS/BW/latency/error results; drive health/endurance/temperature and PCIe/AER/controller/kernel/SEL logs; boot IDs proving no reboot; hang monitoring; cleanup/restore and final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed IOmeter profile and platform/device health limits. Pass requires every approved target active for the full 48-hour measurement, zero disallowed I/O errors, no hang/reboot, no target omission and acceptable device/controller/PCIe/endurance/thermal health. Preparation time, partial target coverage or GUI screenshots alone are insufficient.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not format/select a drive by transient letter/name; include OS/data/RAID/protected media; use an unreviewed Default profile; count preparation toward 48 hours; change cache/power during run; automate unsupported GUI actions; hide per-volume errors; clear logs; auto-restart or auto-retry after failure.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Storage owner signs each target/data loss/endurance and restore; test owner signs config/timing; operator performs provisioning/GUI steps; lab owner approves 48-hour window/recovery; human judges result.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Drive provisioning and GUI target/config verification are manual. A validated config/worker may automate the run and evidence collection after gates.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On wrong target, I/O error, hang/reboot or limit, stop workers if safe, freeze further writes, preserve config/results/health/boot/log evidence, recover host/controller only by approved steps and restore/reprovision each volume; no automatic continuation.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Any target/config/timing/approval/recovery missing; wrong/omitted volume; worker not active; unexpected profile; I/O/media/controller/AER error; temperature/endurance limit; heartbeat loss, hang, reboot, device disappearance, evidence/storage loss or failed restore.

identified_defects: Default access profile and QD ownership are undefined.
Preparation can be confused with the required 48-hour active run.
reason_for_change: Preserve the 48-hour all-volume stress while separating destructive provisioning, IOmeter preparation and actual measurement and proving every target stayed active.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-Storage-00071-V002
new_technical_evidence.supports: All-volume formatting, outstanding I/O 16, Default profile, Preparing Drives and minimum 48-hour run.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Exact workload/config and target exclusions absent.

removed_ambiguities: Defines per-volume target coverage and QD semantics as required input.
resolved_blockers: Licensed config/operator/targets can be supplied; hybrid flow is technically automatable.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 makes the 48-hour clock begin only after every worker leaves Preparing Drives, requires a worker-to-volume coverage proof, and captures boot IDs plus per-device endurance so a partial or auto-restarted run cannot pass.

agent_understanding_result.notes: First contract-only validation preserved target, duration and health boundaries but found that the purpose prematurely described 16 outstanding I/Os as per-target. After revision, revalidation was CLEAR: the source UI value 16 is preserved while its effective per-worker/target/disk/total scope requires owner decision, exported-config calculation and achieved-load evidence; preparation remains outside the 48-hour active window, all volumes require persistent identity and per-volume health, and no restart is allowed. This is not independent-model or DUT validation.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Compatibility row 88 formats every drive volume, selects all IOmeter targets at outstanding I/O 16 and requires at least 48 hours after potentially long preparation.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 protects targets/duration; V3 adds preparation boundary, per-volume coverage, reboot/hang and endurance proof.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Read-only inventory only until every destructive/config/recovery gate is signed.
